Liberation War based play staged in Jamalpur
2015-03-30T00:00:00+06:00 | Our Correspondent, Jamalpur
https://www.thedailystar.net/arts-entertainment/theatre/liberation-war-based-play-staged-jamalpur-74487

A Liberation War- based play, "Eikhane Shobkhane", directed by Fahim Maleque Evan and written by Shahin Rahman was staged on March 25 and 26 at District Shilpakala Academy and Government Ashek Mahmud College auditorium in the district town.

Theatre Aungon, a theatre group of Jamalpur, produced the drama on the occasion of Independence Day. This was the maiden show of the play.

The play centres on the departed souls of martyred Freedom Fighters who express disappointment over the situation in the country even after 44 years of independence.

The souls reflect their deep concern over the establishment of anti-liberation forces -- Al Badr, Al Shams and Rajakars. The disillusioned souls question why they fought for freedom and sacrificed their lives.

The transfixed audiences watched the play in silence.
